editorial.blurb: NAIA brings Mediterranean elegance to the Riverwalk with exquisite, comforting cuisine and exceptional hospitality that makes every visit feel like a celebration.
editorial.insiderTip: Happy Hour is available only at the bar, not for full-table reservations—so plan accordingly if you want those cocktail deals. Arrive early during lunch for a less hectic experience.

topDishes.note: Outstanding collection featuring standout Beet Tzatziki and Truffle Honey Labneh
Comes with fun tableside sauce service
